attempts.summary: Created an SSH host certificate authority on node1 and configured sshd to present a CA-signed host certificate. Verified a client trusting only the CA public key (no host-key pinning) connects and accepts the host via certificate trust. Restarted node1 using the native safe reboot mechanism, confirmed a changed boot_id, and re-verified sshd, the certificate, and CA-based client trust all recovered correctly post-restart.
